luckytntlib.config.multithreaded_explosi: Large explosions will use multiple threads to increase performance. They will run in parallel to each other and the game, stressing CPU and RAM. Adjust the value below to control how many explosions can run simultaneously. On servers, this value must be configured in the server config instead.
luckytntlib.config.max_explosion_threads: Sets the number of explosions that can run in parallel. Each explosion will use multiple threads automatically. Excess explosions will be queued, not discarded. A higher value allows for faster calculation of multiple explosions. On servers, this value must be configured in the server config instead.
luckytntlib.config.multithreading_thresh: Defines the size at which explosions start being multi-threaded. For reference, TNTx500 has a size of 80, TNTx2000 has a size of 160, and TNTx10000 has a size of 300. On servers, this value must be configured in the server config instead.
luckytntlib.config.update_block_light_to: More performant explosions execute light updates themselves to decrease calculation time. Activating this will increase the visual quality of the light updates at the cost of performance. On servers, this value must be configured in the server config instead.
luckytntlib.config.block_update_threshol: Defines the size at which explosions no longer perform automatic block updates. For reference, Supernova has the size 200. This setting has a large impact on performance. On servers, this value must be configured in the server config instead.
luckytntlib.config.performant_explosion_:
Deprecated. See the mod implementing this library as to whether or not this value still has effect.
Replaces the standard explosion with an identical one that reduces loading time at the expense of some detail. If you host a server you will have to change this value in the server config instead.

Deprecated. See the mod implementing this library as to whether or not this value still has effect.
Lower values retain more details while higher values provide more performance. Has significant impact on the shape of explosions. If you host a server you will have to change this value in the server config instead.
